facts: The test reached all 18 logged returns but failed its unchanged 420000 ms budget before opening the second host. No executive after-reload, historical-source or unauthenticated-download acceptance can be inferred.

The original driver performed two full fresh preparations before testing an already observed empty installed model list; those calls consumed 486787 ms and are an independently removable own-driver cost.

The four Meeting input/negative preparations occurred after DOCX/PPTX persistence and took 462999 ms in total. Before export, initial Executive preparation took 5213 ms. These are different operations/shapes; the comparison does not isolate one performance cause.

Published report storage writes full bytes as base64 into state.documents[ref]. The executed C08 state provider passes structuredClone(state) to every read callback, including a case/review-only callback; its clone contains the report document data.

The executed Meeting producer composes twice. Each composition reads the case and the preserved review; the current protected review wrapper invokes the canonical reader twice plus two C08 receipt reads. Those reads preserve necessary authority/integrity semantics but repeat the whole-state cloning path.

Latest WP10 head 532da498 publishes request-local review read scope in review-read-integrity 2a04d865. However review-services c07d55c7 enables localSnapshotReaders only when readers is absent or entirely undefined. Final host bdf6d4e2 supplies residentReviewReaders.readers with actual contributions/outcome and extended-business-services a57e9d39 forwards it. This installed path therefore uses legacyRead; it must not be made to appear local by dropping the real readers.

The latest protectedApplication wraps Review HTTP in readScope.run. The analysis HTTP path calls the input producer with the review reader directly; no readScope.run appears in the inspected final host or producer. The disabled localSnapshotReaders gate already suffices to exclude that optimization here.

Latest review-resident-readers d5b1a0cb only extracts the same contribution/outcome composition. It does not change report storage, Meeting input preparation or C08 copying. Latest storage bf91209e changes the creation-policy stamp check, while the base64 storage remains. C08 2fd55c73 and Meeting producer 672a24c3 are unchanged.
